name: Wispmother
location: Expand for Locations listClose Locations list

abilities.name: Rain of Wisps
abilities.description: The wispmother summons a volley of wisps that crash into the ground all around its position, indicated by numerous red circles, each dealing moderate frost damage.

abilities.name: Clone
abilities.description: The wispmother summons two clones of itself with its current Health as well as having identical appearance and mimicking its attacks. They disappear when the wispmother is defeated.

abilities.name: Summon Wisp
abilities.description: All throughout the fight, wisps passively appear near the wispmother to attack its target.

notes: During the quest Broken Apart, a wispmother is able to disguise herself as the Altmer, Alanya, and manifest an entire alternate reality in the shape of Valrendil and Alanya's home.
The wispmothers found in the March of Sacrifices are considerably larger than those found elsewhere.
A Wispmother is seen on top of a stone arch in the Feral Gallery.
After Update 6, the Wispmother at Snapleg Cave was renamed to Frostmaiden Apa.
related_quests: Azura's Aid: Cleanse the Shrine of Azura and pray for guidance.
Broken Apart: Banish the wispmother that is corrupting Deep Graves.
Buried Evil: Avenge the fallen warriors in Hrota Cave.
Saving Hosni: Take another trip into the Dreamstride at the At-Tura Estate.

West Weald Wispmothers are ghostlike, feminine creatures that are usually accompanied by wisps. They are predominantly found in cold areas, but can also be found along some waterways throughout Tamriel.
